question: How wide is the omega-direction LM basin when omega-magnitude is pinned at truth?
hypothesis: Pinning omega-mag at truth widens the omega-dir basin to roughly 1.5-3deg (vs the s003 ~1deg joint tube).
narrative_md: At pinned truth-omega-magnitude the omega-direction LM basin radius is 3-5deg across seeds 6/28/44 (seed 44 narrowest at 3-4deg, seeds 6/28 >=4deg), 3-5x wider than the s003 joint dir+mag '1deg tube'. Outcome exceeded the pre-registered 1.5-3deg prediction; makes a bracket-augmented omega grid (~7500 cells/seed) feasible.
